verdict.rationale: Ironclad publishes a developer hub with a per-endpoint API reference (e.g., create, list, retrieve, update and delete webhook pages; authentication and Records/Workflows API references) and guides with simple REST examples such as launching a workflow. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or that examples can be run in-browser, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. missing for 10: evidence of interactive 'try it' / runnable request functionality in the reference, a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec, hands-on or independent corroboration of the reference experience.
